VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeDef.description: Peaceful farm animals that occasionally shed metallic husks that can be used as steel, thus negating the need for heavy machinery in mining operations.
VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeDef.label: ironhusk beetle

VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeDef.description: Very large arthropods reminiscent of oversized Hercules beetles, they are peaceful herbivores that originate from a mysterious Rimworld orbiting a very faint star, perpetually covered in darkness.
VanillaRanchingExpanded.FeratypeDef.label: crepuscular beetle
